summary: The WelcomeInstructor page is part of the HSPnet framework and facilitates the management and interaction of instructors with the system. It includes functionality for managing instructor profiles, accessing course and term information, handling placement details, prerequisites, and generating reports. It is integrated with the HSPnet framework for global resource handling and session management.
purpose: To provide instructors with a comprehensive portal within HSPnet for managing placements, prerequisites, and their profile settings.

workflows.name: Instructor Placement Management
steps: Load instructor page with session data
Select course and term from dropdowns
Generate reports based on selected criteria

workflows.name: User Session Management
steps: Manage session data for reporting and preprocessing

business_rules: Instructors are only allowed to view and manage placements if authorized.
Prerequisites can be navigated through a tabbed interface and depend on session data.
Placements can only be printed by users with the proper permissions.
System administrators have broader permissions across the platform.
validations: Check if user session is valid before allowing access
Validate dropdown selections for courses and terms
Ensure prerequisites are visible only if applicable for the session
calculations: Calculate placement durations based on hours and shifts
Determine visibility of placement options based on session attributes
Parse and format rotation strings in the report
conditions: User session must be active to access placement details
Courses and terms must be selected for report generation
Prerequisite tabs are dependant on user session attributes
system_behavior: System hides certain UI elements based on session state
ScriptManager facilitates AJAX updates and control visibility
Reports are generated dynamically based on user input
exceptions: Session expiration results in user redirection
Invalid session data prevents access to the instructor portal
Failed report generation displays an error message
